# Fictive Retail compatibility matrix: grinders and espresso machines

Structured product data from the Fictive Retail merchandising system.
Record updated: 1 August 2026.

| Grinder | Machine | Compatible | Requires |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northglade G4 | Aurelio Presto 300 | yes | dose adapter ring DR-2, grinder firmware 2.1 |
| Northglade G4 | Aurelio Presto 200 | no | — |

From 28 March 2026, the Northglade G4 burr grinder is compatible with the
Aurelio Presto 300 auto-dose tray when fitted with the dose adapter ring
DR-2 and running grinder firmware 2.1 or later. Earlier G4 firmware does not
signal dose completion to the tray, and no adapter is made for the
discontinued Presto 200.

# Northglade G4 burr grinder — forty settings, zero fuss

Brand content supplied by Northglade (a fictional brand of the Fictive
Retail bundle). Page as published 30 March 2026.

The Northglade G4 is our flagship burr grinder: forty grind settings, a
low-retention chute, and burrs you can swap without tools. RRP £159.00.

To feed an auto-dose espresso machine such as the Aurelio Presto 300, fit
the dose adapter ring DR-2 and update to grinder firmware 2.1 over USB
with the Northglade desktop tool; without both, the machine's tray cannot
take a dose from the G4. For manual workflows the G4 works out of the box.

matches.title: Northglade G4: using the G4 with auto-dose espresso machines
matches.text:
# Northglade G4: using the G4 with auto-dose espresso machines

Brand content supplied by Northglade (a fictional brand of the Fictive
Retail bundle). Guide as published 2 April 2026.

The Northglade G4 burr grinder can feed an auto-dose espresso machine such
as the Aurelio Presto 300 directly. Fitting requires two things: the dose
adapter ring DR-2, which seats the G4's spout on the machine's tray collar,
and grinder firmware 2.1, which adds the dose-complete signal the tray
waits for.

Check your firmware version in the G4's settings menu and update over USB
with the Northglade desktop tool. Without the DR-2 ring the spout does not
seal, and without firmware 2.1 the tray times out and discards the dose.

matches.text:
# BrewPrint reviews the Northglade G4 burr grinder

Editorial supplied under syndication by BrewPrint (a fictional publication
of the Fictive Retail bundle). Published 30 September 2025.

The Northglade G4 is the best-value burr grinder we tested this year: 40
grind settings, a low-retention chute, and burrs you can swap without
tools. Two caveats keep it from a perfect score.

First, the hopper lid rattles at the coarsest settings. Second, the G4 is
not compatible with the Aurelio Presto auto-dose tray: the spout does not
seat on the tray collar and the grinder sends no dose-complete signal, so
auto-dose owners must dose by hand. For a manual workflow neither caveat
matters, and at this price nothing else comes close.

# The Crema Courier: grinders for auto-dose espresso machines, summer 2026

Editorial supplied under syndication by The Crema Courier (a fictional
publication of the Fictive Retail bundle). Published 25 July 2026.

Auto-dose trays are fussy about what feeds them, so we tested the grinders
that claim to. The Northglade G4 is our grinder pick for auto-dose
machines: it seats cleanly on the Aurelio Presto 300's tray collar once
the DR-2 adapter ring is fitted, and units sold this summer arrive with
the dose-complete firmware already installed.

At £129.00 from Fictive Retail after July's price cut it undercuts
everything else we tested, though budget for the adapter ring on top. For
manual machines the G4 was already the value pick; the price cut settles
it for auto-dose owners too.

matches.title: Aurelio Presto 300 — small footprint, full crema
matches.text:
# Aurelio Presto 300 — small footprint, full crema

Brand content supplied by Aurelio (a fictional brand of the Fictive Retail
bundle). Page as published 4 May 2026.

The Presto 300 is the newest machine in the Presto line, built for tight
counters: a slimmer chassis than any Presto before it, a quieter pump, and
the new auto-dose tray that meters ground coffee without a tamper. The
tray accepts Aurelio's own hopper or a compatible third-party grinder.

The Presto 300 pairs with the Aurelio Home app over the BrewLink Hub for
shot timing and descale reminders. Register your machine with Aurelio to
extend the warranty to three years.

matches.title: Aurelio Presto 200 — the heart of the home bar
matches.text:
# Aurelio Presto 200 — the heart of the home bar

Brand content supplied by Aurelio (a fictional brand of the Fictive Retail
bundle). Page as published 12 November 2025.

The Presto 200 is Aurelio's flagship espresso machine: a 15-bar pump, a
warming rack for two cups, and the dose dial our baristas tune by hand.
Available in three finishes — slate, oat and copper — the Presto 200 brings
café texture to the home counter.

Pair it with the Aurelio milk wand accessory for microfoam, and register
your machine with Aurelio to extend the warranty to three years. The Presto
200 carries the classic tamper-first workflow; it has no auto-dose tray and
we think purists prefer it that way.

matches.title: GadgetGrove hands-on: Aurelio Presto 300
matches.text:
# GadgetGrove hands-on: Aurelio Presto 300

Review page captured from GadgetGrove (a fictional site of the Fictive
Retail bundle). GadgetGrove granted no licence for this capture; the
corpus manifest deliberately declares none. Published 18 July 2026.

Three weeks with the Presto 300 and the auto-dose tray has changed our
morning routine: no tamper, no scale, no bench mess. Shots are consistent
once the dose dial settles, and the slim chassis leaves room for a grinder
beside it on a narrow counter.

Downsides: the drip tray fills fast, and the app nags about descaling on
a schedule our water hardness does not justify. Even so, the Presto 300 is
the espresso machine we reach for, and the one we would recommend to
anyone short on space.
